config_source:
# User-adjustable uncertainty propagation protocol. run.py parses this file as DIPL.
uncertainty_propagation
  execution
    target
      source str = "pinned"
        ?descr "Use the configured SNT3 package pin or the neighboring local source checkout."

    paths
      local_repo str = "../scinumtools3"
        ?descr "SNT3 source checkout used when execution.target.source is local."

      local_python_base str = ".venv/bin/python"
        ?descr "Python interpreter path relative to local_repo; its ABI must match the built extension."

    python_base str = "python3.13"
      ?descr "Interpreter used to create the isolated pinned environment."

    output_dir str = "benchmarks/uncertainty-propagation/results"
      ?descr "Directory for timestamped result sets, relative to the repository root."

    libraries str[:] = ["snt", "pint", "metrolopy"]
      ?descr "Libraries included in this run; Pint uses uncertainties and MetroloPy reports GUM first-order standard uncertainties."

    samples int = 200000
      ?descr "Monte Carlo draws per case; increase to reduce sampling noise."

    seed int = 20261025
      ?descr "Fixed NumPy generator seed for reproducible independent normal inputs."

    figure_dpi int = 160
      ?descr "Resolution of the summary figure."

  workload
    selection
      cases str[:] = ["*"]
        ?descr "Case ID glob patterns to run."

    # Case inputs and output models are configured independently below.
    linear_conversion
      nominal float = 20.0
        ?descr "Nominal temperature in degrees Celsius."

      standard_deviation float = 0.2
        ?descr "One-standard-deviation input spread in degrees Celsius."

      source_unit str = "degC"
        ?descr "Input temperature point unit."

      target_unit str = "degF"
        ?descr "Output temperature point unit."

      scale_num int = 9
        ?descr "Exact coefficient numerator in the affine Celsius-to-Fahrenheit reference."

      scale_den int = 5
        ?descr "Exact coefficient denominator in the affine Celsius-to-Fahrenheit reference."

      offset_num int = 32
        ?descr "Exact offset numerator in the affine Celsius-to-Fahrenheit reference."

      offset_den int = 1
        ?descr "Exact offset denominator in the affine Celsius-to-Fahrenheit reference."

    addition
      x float = 10.0
        ?descr "First addend nominal value."

      sigma_x float = 0.2
        ?descr "First addend standard deviation."

      y float = 4.0
        ?descr "Second addend nominal value."

      sigma_y float = 0.3
        ?descr "Second addend standard deviation."

      unit str = "m"
        ?descr "Unit shared by the two addends."

    product
      x float = 10.0
        ?descr "First factor nominal value."

      sigma_x float = 0.2
        ?descr "First factor standard deviation."

      y float = 4.0
        ?descr "Second factor nominal value."

      sigma_y float = 0.3
        ?descr "Second factor standard deviation."

      x_unit str = "m"
        ?descr "Unit of the first factor."

      y_unit str = "s"
        ?descr "Unit of the second factor."

    reciprocal
      x float = 4.0
        ?descr "Denominator nominal value; keep its distribution away from zero."

      sigma_x float = 0.1
        ?descr "Denominator standard deviation."

      unit str = "s"
        ?descr "Unit of the denominator."

    square_nonlinear
      x float = 0.5
        ?descr "Nominal input to the square model."

      sigma_x float = 0.4
        ?descr "Input standard deviation; a large ratio to x makes the output distribution asymmetric."

      unit str = "m"
        ?descr "Input unit; output unit is its square."

    correlated_addition
      x float = 10.0
        ?descr "First addend nominal value."

      sigma_x float = 0.2
        ?descr "First addend standard deviation."

      y float = 4.0
        ?descr "Second addend nominal value."

      sigma_y float = 0.3
        ?descr "Second addend standard deviation."

      correlation float = 0.8
        ?descr "Correlation coefficient shared by sampling and each library's input model."

      unit str = "m"
        ?descr "Unit shared by the correlated addends."

    rectangular_linear
      x float = 10.0
        ?descr "Center of the rectangular input distribution."

      standard_deviation float = 0.2
        ?descr "Standard deviation of the rectangular distribution; half-width is sqrt(3) times this value."

      unit str = "m"
        ?descr "Unit of the rectangular input and its propagated result."

  semantics
    normal_coverage float = 0.95
      ?descr "Central Monte Carlo coverage interval requested for the reported propagation interval."

    one_sigma_normal_coverage float = 0.6826894921370859
      ?descr "Reference coverage for a symmetric plus/minus one-standard-deviation interval under a normal output model."

    tolerance_relative float = 0.03
      ?descr "Relative tolerance for closed-form-reference versus Monte Carlo standard deviation checks."

  packages
    snt
      version str = "0.9.8"
        ?descr "Pinned SNT3 release whose PUQ uncertainty model is under comparison."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/scinumtools3/0.9.8/"

      website str = "https://github.com/scinumtools/snt3"
        ?descr "SNT3 source repository and project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/scinumtools3/0.9.8/"

    pint
      version str = "0.26.2"
        ?descr "Pinned Pint release used in the comparison."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/Pint/0.26.2/"

      website str = "https://pint.readthedocs.io/en/0.26.2/"
        ?descr "Versioned Pint documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/Pint/0.26.2/"

    uncertainties
      version str = "3.2.3"
        ?descr "Pinned optional package used by Pint's uncertainty integration."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/uncertainties/3.2.3/ (3.2.4 is yanked)."

      website str = "https://uncertainties.readthedocs.io/"
        ?descr "uncertainties documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/uncertainties/3.2.3/"

    numpy
      version str = "2.5.4"
        ?descr "Pinned random-number and Monte Carlo array package."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/numpy/2.5.4/"

      website str = "https://numpy.org/"
        ?descr "NumPy project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/numpy/2.5.4/"

    matplotlib
      version str = "3.11.2"
        ?descr "Pinned figure rendering package."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/matplotlib/3.11.2/"

      website str = "https://matplotlib.org/"
        ?descr "Matplotlib project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/matplotlib/3.11.2/"

    metrolopy
      version str = "1.1.1"
        ?descr "Pinned MetroloPy release for unit-aware first-order uncertainty propagation."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/metrolopy/1.1.1/"

      website str = "https://nrc-cnrc.github.io/MetroloPy/"
        ?descr "MetroloPy documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/metrolopy/1.1.1/"

    scipy
      version str = "1.18.1"
        ?descr "Pinned MetroloPy numerical dependency."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/scipy/1.18.1/"

      website str = "https://scipy.org/"
        ?descr "SciPy project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/scipy/1.18.1/"

    pandas
      version str = "3.1.0"
        ?descr "Pinned MetroloPy data dependency."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/pandas/3.1.0/"

      website str = "https://pandas.pydata.org/"
        ?descr "pandas project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/pandas/3.1.0/"

    ipython
      version str = "9.17.1"
        ?descr "Pinned MetroloPy runtime dependency."
        ?rationale "Release: https://pypi.org/project/ipython/9.17.1/"

      website str = "https://ipython.org/"
        ?descr "IPython project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/ipython/9.17.1/"

  provenance
    gum str = "https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM100-2008E"

    gum_amendment_2026 str = "https://doi.org/10.59161/PPDI3267"

    monte_carlo str = "https://doi.org/10.59161/JCGM101-2008"

    pint_uncertainties str = "https://pint.readthedocs.io/en/0.26.2/getting/overview.html"

    metrolopy str = "https://nrc-cnrc.github.io/MetroloPy/_build/html/metrolopy.html"

    uncertainty_model str = "https://github.com/scinumtools/snt3/blob/ab0597d8c3a304a8282f2098e5af45a67e86ac0d/docs/puel/sections/uncertainty.md"
